India won the match comfortably after chasing the revised target of 143 runs in just 22.4 overs. While Arshdeep took four wickets, he conceded 23 runs in his final over, affecting his overall figures. Anshul Kamboj was also recognized for his economical bowling, winning the Player of the Match award.
